intro.uz: Bu — mehmonxona qabulxonasidagi suhbat. Oʻqishdan oldin: mehmonxonaga kelganda qanday savollar berasiz?

paragraphs.en: Receptionist: Good evening! Welcome to our hotel. Can I help you? Kamola: Good evening. My name is Kamola Rahimova. I have a room for two nights.
paragraphs.uz: Administrator: Xayrli kech! Mehmonxonamizga xush kelibsiz. Sizga yordam bera olamanmi? Kamola: Xayrli kech. Mening ismim Kamola Rahimova. Menga ikki kechaga xona band qilingan.

paragraphs.en: Receptionist: Yes, Ms Rahimova. Your room is 205. It is on the second floor. Here is your key.
paragraphs.uz: Administrator: Ha, Rahimova xonim. Sizning xonangiz — 205. U ikkinchi qavatda. Mana kalitingiz.

paragraphs.en: Kamola: Thank you. Is there a lift? Receptionist: Yes, there is. It is next to the stairs.
paragraphs.uz: Kamola: Rahmat. Lift bormi? Administrator: Ha, bor. U zinapoyaning yonida.

paragraphs.en: Kamola: What time is breakfast? Receptionist: Breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant.
paragraphs.uz: Kamola: Nonushta soat nechada? Administrator: Nonushta restoranda soat yettidan oʻngacha.

paragraphs.en: Kamola: Can I use the wifi? Receptionist: Yes, of course. The password is on this card. Have a nice evening!
paragraphs.uz: Kamola: Wi-Fiʼdan foydalansam boʻladimi? Administrator: Ha, albatta. Parol mana shu kartochkada. Kechingiz xayrli oʻtsin!
